programs.title: Come Dine with Me
programs.desc: New Zealand-born Craig hopes that his lobster and wild boar will blow his rivals out of the water. But the brewing tension threatens to boil over.

programs.title: Four in a Bed
programs.desc: The first visit is to Harrogate, where management team 'Clarkey' and Katie help to run the 64-bedroom White Hart Hotel. The extra charge for posh coffee at breakfast causes a stir.

programs.title: Four in a Bed
programs.desc: The second visit is to Raouf and his friend Chrissie at the New Promenade Hotel in Blackpool. There's a teetering toilet seat, and Clarkey and Katie are turned off by muck on the taps.

programs.title: Four in a Bed
programs.desc: Vicky Crawford welcomes her rivals to her aptly named terrace house, The Terrace, in Oxford. Two pairs of guests make some grim discoveries, including hairs and a pre-sucked sweet.

programs.title: Four in a Bed
programs.desc: The final visit is to Robin and Liza's Georgian mansion, Tall John's House, in the Brecon Beacons. The guests gush over their new friendships, but Vicky doesn't seem to share the sentiment.

programs.title: Four in a Bed
programs.desc: It's the final day of the competition and the B&Bers meet for the last time to settle some scores. There's anger as well as tears of joy when the winner is revealed.
